prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a narrow railway track cutting through a dense forest in Le Prarion, Chamonix-Mont-Blanc, France. The camera glides smoothly over the gravel bed, flanked by tall evergreen trees whose branches occasionally sway gently in the breeze. As the viewer progresses, the foggy atmosphere diffuses the light, casting a soft, muted glow that filters through the canopy above. The railway tracks, embedded with wooden sleepers, stretch straight ahead, curving slightly to the right as the path continues deeper into the woods. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive view of the surrounding environment. To the left, a series of utility poles with overhead wires run parallel to the tracks, while the right side features a sloping hill covered in grass and scattered rocks. The terrain gradually ascends, and the camera pans slightly upward, revealing more of the forested landscape. The cloudy sky above casts a uniform light, enhancing the earthy tones of the trees and undergrowth. As the journey continues, the path veers off the tracks onto a dirt trail, leading uphill through the misty woodland. The camera follows this new direction, capturing the rugged texture of the ground and the dense foliage that frames the scene. The overall ambiance remains serene and untouched, with no signs of human presence apart from the railway infrastructure.
